metadata.description: Rules, skills, safety guard, action journal and MCP configs for every role on a software team. One source of truth for all your team's AI agents.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Everyone installs this: task protocol, handoffs, scope rules, the safety guard and action journal, the task board MCP and agent-mcp.

plugins.name: gitlab-tools
plugins.description: GitLab MCP server, when your code lives on GitLab.

plugins.name: github-tools
plugins.description: GitHub's MCP server, when your code lives on GitHub.

plugins.name: jenkins-tools
plugins.description: Jenkins MCP server (read; devops may run non-production jobs).

plugins.name: role-product
plugins.description: Write well-formed tasks, prioritise the board, review what triage sorted, approve reviews and answer product questions.

plugins.name: role-design
plugins.description: Figma design handoffs to backend and frontend, and design change requests.

plugins.name: role-backend
plugins.description: Backend workflow, API contracts and their handoff to frontend, the E2E test workflow, turning Figma designs into tasks.

plugins.name: role-frontend
plugins.description: Integrate designs and backend API contracts into the frontend.

plugins.name: role-data
plugins.description: Deliver the data the product needs: warehouse queries, tables and views, BI questions and data jobs, written as files and merge requests and applied by a person.

plugins.name: role-devops
plugins.description: CI/CD pipelines, deployment setup, servers and containers, monitoring and alerts. May run non-production pipelines and CI jobs (core role must be devops); never production deploys, merges to main or database writes.
